description: A group route Port OS resolved for this dispatch. The plugin addresses it by its own pluginRouteId and cookie (the group route's pluginCustomMetadata).

groupId.description: Canonical endpoint group the group route belongs to, after merge redirects.

pluginRouteId.description: The plugin's own identifier for the group route, as reported in discovery.

cookie.description: The group route's pluginCustomMetadata, as reported in discovery.
